**What are you trying to measure?**
The research question, in one or two sentences.

**What have you tried?**
Code, configuration, and the command you ran.

**What did the output say?**
Paste the relevant report/evidence fields. Do not paste confidential
participant data.

**Which documentation did you consult?**
Link the README / `docs/USER_MANUAL.md` section, so we can improve the
docs if they were unclear.
